notes: This is a passive 2-way horn-loaded weather-resistant loudspeaker (12in woofer + 1in compression driver, 8ohm nominal, 200W cont./500W program, crossover at 2kHz), manufactured by Community Professional Loudspeakers (a Biamp brand). The manufacturer datasheet explicitly states "Input Connection: 12 foot (4m) SJOW #16 gauge cable with stripped ends" — there is no connector or terminal cup on the enclosure; it is a permanently attached flying-lead pigtail that installers splice/wire-nut directly to amplifier speaker cable in the field. None of the allowed connector IDs represent a bare-wire pigtail, so "euroblock" was used as the closest analog for a field-wired screw/terminal-style connection — this is an approximation, not a literal port on the unit. No power input port exists because this is a passive (non-powered) loudspeaker with no AC/DC power requirement. Datasheet states "Controls: None" and no other physical I/O (no pass-through jack). Dimensions 16 x 16 x 15.94 in, weight 35 lbs (desktop/pole/yoke-mounted, not rack-mountable, so rackUnits omitted). All electrical/physical specs are confirmed from the authoritative manufacturer datasheet; medium confidence reflects only the connector-encoding approximation, not any doubt about the underlying facts.
